faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Data Entry Operator position is 27th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate or 12th grade from a recognized board and possess a computer course/diploma from a recognized institute. Two years of experience in data management is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Entry Operator post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Data Entry Operator role at AIIMS Delhi will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Data Entry Operator position at AIIMS Delhi is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Data Entry Operator position will be as per ICMR Rules.

faq.question: Q8. How should I send my application?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email to the official email address provided in the notification. Ensure to include all required documents and details.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Delhi apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies AIIMS Delhi, so candidates from all over India are generally eligible unless otherwise stated in the official notification. Please refer to the official PDF for specific details.
